evidence.decision: Selects recognizable concept, quiet opaque background, meaningful foreground layers, unmasked canvas and platform-appropriate construction/appearances.
evidence.artifact: Delivers corrected icon artwork/specification or scoped review with explicit layer and variant inventory.
evidence.transformation: Book-club pre-rounded screenshot with temporary badge/tiny titles becomes simple unmasked overlapping-book layers; temporary copy moves into content.
evidence.verification: Checks small-size identity, mask loss and focus/lighting shape changes; does not treat a flat mockup as verified parallax/export behavior.
evidence.applicability: Differentiates Icon Composer versus image-stack workflow, TV crop, spatial hollow-depth risk, Watch black separation and per-platform specifications.
evidence.handoffs: Routes supporting formats to Images, interface actions to Icons and brand consistency to Branding.
evidence.distinctiveness: Launcher identity under masks, layer effects and appearance variants determines asset production rather than generic aesthetic advice.
